answer: Because the timing is recorded against the nectar challenge, the saffron audit can replay the spiral history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 281 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
